t: This Soudal Trade Multi-Purpose Acetoxy Silicone Sealant is a high-performance joint filler designed to create a flexible, weathertight barrier on common building materials. Ideal for trade professionals sealing joints in kitchens, bathrooms and external window frames, this waterproof sealant adheres to glass, metals, wood and ceramic tiles. The solvent-free formula contains a powerful fungicide to resist mould growth, ensuring a clean finish in high-moisture areas. Supplied in a convenient 270ml cartridge to provide a durable, long-lasting seal for both interior and exterior building applications.
